hostResources.title: Host System Resources
hostResources.noData: No history data available yet. Data is collected every 30 seconds.

banner.usage: {{percent}}% used — {{free}} free of {{total}} on the disk holding {{roles}}
banner.forecast: Growing about {{growth}} a day; at this rate it is full in about {{days}} days.
banner.hint: Logs are what fills a home server. Shorten log retention or add disk space before the database runs out of room.

emergency.running: Compressing older log chunks to win space back (nothing is deleted): {{done}}/{{total}}
emergency.done: Compressed {{count}} older log chunk(s) and freed {{freed}}. Nothing was deleted.
emergency.dryRun: Dry run: {{count}} older log chunk(s) could be compressed. Nothing was changed (NPG_DISK_EMERGENCY_COMPRESS=dryrun).
emergency.off: Emergency compression is turned off (NPG_DISK_EMERGENCY_COMPRESS=off). Free some space by hand.

blocked.insufficient_space: Too little free space to compress older logs safely. Free some space by hand.
blocked.nothing_to_compress: Older logs are already compressed. Free some space by hand.
blocked.policy_running: The scheduled log compression is running right now; trying again in a minute.
blocked.another_pass_running: Another job is rewriting log chunks right now; trying again in a minute.
blocked.chunks_busy: The older log chunks are busy with another job; trying again in a minute.
blocked.db_disk_unmeasured: The database disk could not be measured, so nothing was compressed.
blocked.compress_failed: Compressing older logs failed. See the API container log.
blocked.error: Emergency compression stopped. See the API container log.

dbReason.db_container_not_found: set NPG_DB_CONTAINER to your database container's name
dbReason.db_external: the database is not on this host
dbReason.db_exec_failed: running stat in the database container failed
dbReason.docker_unavailable: Docker is not reachable from the API

storage.stalled: Not answering, so not measured (a hung network mount?): {{disks}}
